goal: A deep construction product: spec book PDF to submittal register, measured on real tagged data
notes: Built ventures/submittal-register (engine, Web Worker PDF reader, page, CLI, eval). Ground truth: UFGS SpecsIntact XML tags each submittal (<ITM> under SD-nn); eval renders sections to printed text and to Chromium PDFs. Results: 690 UFGS_M sections text 99.3% recall / 99.9% precision (12,952 items); 2019 package 99.8/98.7; PDF 60 sections 99.1/99.3, 150 sections (1,954 pages) 98.8/99.4. Browser: 1,954-page PDF read in 25.4 s, no console errors, no horizontal scroll at 390 px. The PDF eval found the PDF reader copied from bank-statement-pdf-to-csv read browser-printed pages bottom to top (5.8% recall); fixed in both ventures, with a regression test in bank-statement-pdf-to-csv that fails before the fix. Also fixed a call-stack overflow (push(...lines)) on 2,000-page books found by the browser run. Not measured: a real commercial SectionFormat project manual (wbdg.org and agency hosts refused the proxy). Checks run: run_venture_tests (submittal-register 18, bank-statement 96 pass), platform/pages faq-visible/secondary-schema/css-lint pass, check_posts ok, validate.py ok, check_csv_formula_guard ok, venture-preflight clean after fixes (catalogue sub-group keyword, BOM escape, ids-model-check<->submittal-register sibling links for the orphan budget, FAQ JSON-LD = visible text, formula guard lets plain numbers through).
